_doc: What the analyst is SUPPOSED to be able to reach. This file is the declaration; the loop probes
it at the start of every cycle and reports anything that does not match (see preflight() in
It exists because the agent spent seventeen cycles with 2 of the estate's 11 MCP servers and a
job description naming four lanes it had no path to. Nothing failed — a tool you were never
given does not announce itself, it is simply absent from what you reach for. The only way that
becomes visible is if something states the intent separately and checks reality against it.
So: when you grant the agent something new, add it HERE too. A capability that is not declared
is not checked, and an undeclared capability that silently disappears is exactly the failure
this file is meant to make impossible.
Read by loop.py exercise_block(). Every tool the declared MCP servers list is rotated through
the loop's TOOL EXERCISE block, least recently used first. `hold`: never called for real,
because it writes somewhere the operator lives or disrupts other agents; the agent checks its
schema instead. `how`: a sandbox recipe for a tool that has side effects but may be called.
A new write tool with neither is reported as needing a recipe, so add one here.

hold.mcp__mcp-google__draft_gmail_message: creates a draft in the operator's own mailbox
hold.mcp__mcp-google__manage_out_of_office: writes the operator's calendar and auto-replies
hold.mcp__mcp-google__start_google_auth: starts an OAuth flow only the operator can finish
hold.mcp__logview__acknowledge_incident: acks a real incident; the triage agent exercises it hourly
hold.mcp__logview__file_issue: writes the operator's issue board; exercised whenever a real issue is filed
hold.mcp__logview__update_issue: writes the operator's issue board; exercised whenever a real issue is updated
hold.mcp__webscout__redeploy: restarts webscout under every agent using it
hold.mcp__webscout__establish_session: replaces a stored login, which can need the operator's second factor

how.mcp__agent-write__create_agent_folder: only under /agent/exercise (create it once if missing)
how.mcp__agent-write__append_agent_doc: only to a doc you created in /agent/exercise

how.mcp__mcp-google__get_gmail_attachment_co: saves to local disk: use a recent attachment, then delete the file
